scope: Native utility primitives needed by unchanged original utilities; compile/link closure and runtime evidence are separate

interfaces.name: LocalVector
interfaces.model: Contiguous trivial Local slots refer to stable wrapper cells owned by Frame/HandleScope. Vector copying, movement, growth, swap, clear and destruction never independently acquire or release those cells. A copied Local remains valid only while its owning scope is alive. Global or EscapableHandleScope is required to cross scope boundaries.
interfaces.referenceRole: Interface and lifetime review only; no V8 implementation/header/heap data adopted into build
interfaces.coverage: Selected imported C++ sources only; not an exhaustive archive-wide native contract census
interfaces.supersedes: Revision61 provisional independently cloned vector roots and intentionally undefined data()

interfaces.name: ArrayBufferView.HasBuffer/CopyContents
interfaces.owner: SpiderMonkey buffer-view representation and atomic operations
interfaces.model: HasBuffer reads ArrayBufferViewObject.hasBuffer without materialization. CopyContents roots and unwraps the view, bounds by current view byte length, accesses inline/backed storage under AutoCheckCannotGC and uses the engine racy byte copy for shared storage. Zero-length/detached views return zero. No backing allocation is forced.

interfaces.name: Isolate.TryGetCurrent/LowMemoryNotification
interfaces.model: Current returns the active native frame isolate or null. LowMemoryNotification asserts foreground ownership, saves actual pending value and throw stack, performs full shrinking collection and restores that exception state.

interfaces.name: per_process.v8_initialized
interfaces.model: The upstream-compatible field begins false. The shell changes it only after successful JS_InitWithFailureDiagnostic and immediately before its scope-exit JS_ShutDown. True is checked against JS_IsInitialized; that public query alone cannot represent shutdown because it intentionally remains true after shutdown.

interfaces.name: Function.SetName
interfaces.owner: SpiderMonkey function and own name property
interfaces.model: Atomizes the actual UTF16 string, replaces the own nonenumerable readonly configurable name property, then sets the actual JSFunction atom. An already resolved own name is updated.
interfaces.limitations: General bound/proxy/nonconfigurable-name compatibility is unvalidated; current consumed helpers install ordinary freshly allocated native functions.
